name: Proofpoint - Possible Business Email Compromise due to urgency requirements
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "message-delivered"
| filter impostorScore >= 60
| filter lowercase(subject) contains "payment"
      or lowercase(subject) contains "wire"
      or lowercase(subject) contains "invoice"
      or lowercase(subject) contains "urgent"
      or lowercase(subject) contains "transfer"
description: A delivered email scored as a possible impostor (impostorScore >= 60) with a finance/urgency subject (payment, wire, invoice, urgent) - possible Business Email Compromise.
alert_name: Proofpoint - Possible BEC due to subject asking for payment or urgency
alert_description:
What fired: Proofpoint delivered a possible-impostor email (impostorScore >= 60) whose subject references payment/wire/invoice/urgency - a classic BEC lure.

Why it matters: BEC drives fraudulent payments and data disclosure, and this message reached the inbox.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped recipient, sender, reply-to and subject.
  - Verify sender legitimacy OUT OF BAND; warn the recipient not to action any payment request.
  - Check for a reply-to / from-address mismatch.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1656 - Impersonation; T1566 - Phishing (TA0001 - Initial Access).
